subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw expose Firecrawl's hosted keyless `/v2/search` tier as an official opt-in `firecrawl-free` web_search provider?
rationale: The implementation shape is now reasonably narrow and live no-auth search worked in review, but accepting this adds a public provider id and a hosted no-auth query path whose privacy and upstream-contract implications are maintainer policy choices.

options.title: Approve opt-in Firecrawl-free search
options.body: Accept `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in provider after the branch is rebased cleanly and keep it non-auto-detected with credential-isolation tests.

options.title: Keep Firecrawl search keyed
options.body: Decline the new provider and keep current Firecrawl search behavior credentialed until the upstream/API-contract or sponsorship direction is firmer.

options.title: Move keyless search out of core
options.body: Ask for this to live as an external plugin/ClawHub package if maintainers do not want the bundled Firecrawl plugin to own the no-auth search surface.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in Firecrawl-free search
recommendation.body: Accept `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in provider after the branch is rebased cleanly and keep it non-auto-detected with credential-isolation tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Firecrawl keyless scrape work and merge history make this the strongest available routing owner for the bundled provider decision.
